remarks: Welcome to Imperial House, a well-maintained condominium complex located in the heart of downtown Stamford. This spacious 2 bedroom, 2 bath unit awaits its' new owner. Hardwood floors adorn most of the unit and brand new carpeting has been installed in the primary bedroom, which features an en-suite full bath and walk-in closet. The full guest bath was updated in the past two years. Also, the entire apartment has been freshly painted. Heat, hot water, gas & sewer included. No rental restrictions. This unit is being sold AS IS. In addition to street parking, there is permit parking available on Hillcrest Avenue and at the Bedford Street Garage.
